journey.name: repay paid invoice
journey.description:
Paying again a Lightning invoice this wallet already paid sends nothing: the second swipe opens Success with the amount the earlier payment sent, also when the repeat typed another amount for an amountless invoice. An invoice that shares the payment hash of another paid invoice is refused as already paid; that case needs a payee that reuses a payment hash and is covered by SendConfirmationViewTests.
Preconditions: two Debug builds on two simulators, each with Spark connected on its regtest (no key needed), no Lightning channel and QuickPay disabled. The payer has a Spark balance of at least 10,000 sats from Lightspark's regtest faucet, sent to the deposit address its Spark connection screen shows (id "SparkDepositAddress"). Bitkit's own invoices carry no Spark address, so the payer pays them over Lightning through Spark's provider.

actions.action: On the payee, tap Receive (id "Receive"), create a Lightning invoice with no amount and copy it as invoice A
On the payer, record the Spending balance, open invoice A with xcrun simctl openurl and a lightning: link, enter 1,000 sats and swipe to pay
Verify the payer's Success screen shows 1,000 sats and the payee received 1,000 sats; close Success
On the payer, open invoice A again with a lightning: link, enter 2,000 sats and swipe to pay
Verify the payer's Success screen shows 1,000 sats, not 2,000; close it and verify the payer's Spending balance did not drop a second time and the payee received nothing new
